title: Ausonius
summary: Raleigh names Ausonius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ausonius noteth that what Virgil hath written of Dido is fabulous, and doth honor her Statua with an Epigramme. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXII, §. VI, sig. 328a
